name: qrtransfer
description: Offline file and text transfer using fountain-coded animated QR codes — screen to camera, no network.

scripts.build: tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && vite build --configLoader runner
scripts.build:web: npm run build && node --import ./build/register-typescript.mjs build/package-web.ts && node build/check-web.mjs
scripts.build:desktop: tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && vite build --mode desktop --configLoader runner && node build/sync-desktop.mjs && node --import ./build/register-typescript.mjs build/package-source.ts desktop/app/web/qrtransfer-source.zip && node build/check-desktop.mjs
scripts.desktop:start: npm run build:desktop && npm --prefix desktop start
scripts.desktop:mac: npm run build:desktop && npm --prefix desktop run dist:mac
scripts.desktop:win: npm run build:desktop && npm --prefix desktop run dist:win
scripts.build:standalone: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-standalone',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc && vite build --mode standalone-send && vite build --mode standalone-receive
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:standalone
scripts.build:android: tsc && vite build --mode android && node build/sync-android.mjs
